blurb: Guests play golf on a 9-hole course with options for walking or cart rental. The course offers private and group golf lessons, weekly club games, and tournament hosting services. Unlimited golf memberships are available with weekday or everyday play options.
extraNote: Juniors (5-17) play free with a paid adult every day after 12pm · Please return carts 30 minutes before closing; play can continue until closing · Twilight begins 4 hours before closing; SuperTwilight begins 2 hours before closing · Unlimited golf memberships can be placed on hold for sickness, vacation, or injury · Check in at the clubhouse 15 minutes prior to scheduled tee time.
